cards.headline: Sakamoto was cast after a photo, without even meeting the director
cards.snippet: For his 1983 war film Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence, director Nagisa Ōshima chose Ryuichi Sakamoto without ever meeting him. He had only seen Sakamoto's photographs in a photo book called Fifty Representative Figures of Today. The film was Sakamoto's first soundtrack and also his first acting role, as Captain Yonoi, alongside David Bowie. Ōshima's film also gave Sakamoto a BAFTA for Best Film Music.
cards.context: The theme comes from Ōshima's 1983 war film, which Sakamoto also acted in alongside David Bowie.

cards.headline: Sakamoto hesitated to ask Bowie to join the soundtrack
cards.snippet: In a 2016 interview with FACT, Ryuichi Sakamoto looked back on making the 1983 film Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence with David Bowie. He said he had considered asking Bowie to work with him on the film's music. He hesitated, he explained, because Bowie seemed very focused on his acting at the time. The remark surfaced as the soundtrack was being reissued by Milan Records that year.
cards.context: Sakamoto told FACT this in 2016. The soundtrack was reissued that year in Milan Records' Nicolas Winding Refn Presents series.

cards.headline: A teenager on the edge, saved by snow and a melody
cards.snippet:
中学生の頃、毎日死にたくて、線路に飛び込もうか悩んでいた。雪が降ってきて、この曲を思い出して泣けてきて、死ぬのをやめた。
今55歳、幸せです。
cards.context: Japanese: as a teen they wanted to die daily; snow fell, they remembered this song, cried, and chose to live. Now 55 and happy.

replies.author: @akam2649
replies.text: 指揮者のサイモン・ラトルは「芸術には時間を止める力がある」と言っていたことを思い出しました。

replies.author: @ナオ尚
replies.text: 線路…。この世の中、どこにいても、いつ何時、事故でお空に行くかもしれません。約40年間、あの頃の気持ちは、まだ、覚えていますか？　でも、まだまだ、、世の中、捨てたものじゃないです。自分を大切にしてください。

cards.headline: Named Ryuichi, he taught himself piano for this one song
cards.snippet:
自分は親に龍一という名前を付けてもらいました。
25歳のいま、ピアノっていいなと思って独学でピアノを始めました。
この曲だけは絶対に弾けるようになりたいです。
cards.context: Japanese: named Ryuichi by his parents, he began teaching himself piano at 25 and wants above all to play this piece.

cards.snippet: I am a 25 year Honorably retired Police Officer with a scorching case of PTSD. This song has helped me immensely in my life.
